first.rationale: Both onboarding completion and activation are down 4-6% QoQ. Memory_31 and memory_86 directly address these metrics—signup simplification and shortened onboarding both improved activation and completion. Verifying these two memories will confirm whether the original mechanisms remain valid and whether we can reapply or refine them. This addresses the core symptom (falling activation/completion) rather than chasing promotional pricing, which would erode margins against a competitor and doesn't address the underlying engagement problem. Referral incentives work for established customers, not new ones. Enterprise sales assist is orthogonal to SMB activation. Activation messaging (memory_91) showed promise but is lighter-touch than addressing the onboarding funnel itself. By fixing onboarding first, we create the foundation for all downstream actions. Standard experiment scale allows measurement without overcommitting resources.
